description: This file contains validation functions for user equipment (UE) configuration in a scheduler, including checks for BWP configurations, PDCCH configs, and CSI measurement configs.

methods.name: validate_bwp_ded_cfg
methods.description: Validates that the dedicated bandwidth part configuration for UE matches the expected configuration, focusing on PDCCH settings.

methods.name: validate_sched_ue_creation_request_message
methods.description: Validates a UE creation request message, ensuring all configurations are consistent and meet requirements.
